Question: as-salamu-alaikum accuataly i want to know about zakat of lic. my anually deduction of lic is 10524, from 2003.last year iwas paid zakat of my lic balance from 2003i know that how calculated the zakat? the tatol balance of 2003 to till or the year of 2009. please guide about my problem. Answer ID: 15413 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1411/1343=B/1430) Calculate the total deposited amount every year and give its Zakah, which is 2.5% of total amount. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
